source: Hand-authored from SPEC.md before product implementation; synthetic open evaluation

invariants.I01: Only armed plus accepted start may enter running
invariants.I02: Invalid inputs must stop running within 10 ms
invariants.I03: Age is tick minus sample time, not receive time; future invalid
invariants.I07: History persists; 1000 ms continuously valid, ack, arm, separate start
invariants.I08: Heartbeat age >300 ms detected by next 10 ms tick
invariants.I09: Exact duplicate not applied twice; conflicting payload rejected
invariants.I11: Stop takes priority over simultaneous start
invariants.I12: Valve error >0.2 continuously >500 ms detected next tick
